n: Cortic AI Toolkit for Raspberry Pi
t: A drag-and-drop AI toolkit for Raspberry Pi whose current status is unverified.
steps: Confirm that the toolkit is still available from Cortic Technology.
Look for a current install guide before you buy anything.
Get a Raspberry Pi 4B and an OAK-D Lite camera.
Ask IT to approve the setup.
Test the install on one Pi.
Try a gesture recognition or vision example.
Plan a lesson only if the test works.
